description: In combination with `esm-scen7-vl-SST`, quantifies the effective radiative forcing (ERF) of a hypothetical continued increase in desert dust. Same as `esm-scen7-vl-SST`, except dust emissions follow the future extension of the Leung et al. (2025) dataset (a linear increase on the present-day pattern of sources). Atmosphere-only counterpart of `esm-scen7-vl-Dust`.
